game: TB @ DAL Week 5 2026 (kickoff time not in pack; spread/total not saved; weather not saved)

script.base: Dallas is home with Dak Prescott against a Bucs team whose QB Baker Mayfield is out (thumb). DAL has the explosive skill volume (CeeDee Lamb 38 targets, 454 yards, 380 air yards in weeks 2-4; Javonte Williams 50 carries, 190 yards) and TB's defense is without S Antoine Winfield Jr., CB Benjamin Morrison and LB SirVocea Dennis, so the base is a moderate DAL lead by the half, not an automatic blowout: TB has allowed only 9 passes of 20+ on 130 attempts and 3.58 rush YPC. TB leans on Bucky Irving early (48 carries, 196 yards in three weeks); if they trail, the unnamed backup throws shorter rather than a shootout.
script.flip1: DAL blows it open early. Williams's carries pile up late, Lamb stalls near his 44-yard floor (the favorite-runs-the-clock kill), and TB abandons Irving so the backup's garbage throws are the only TB volume.
script.flip2: The backup plus Irving keep it inside one score. TB's run defense (3.58 YPC, 8 runs of 10+) stuffs Williams, Lamb plays every snap into the shorthanded secondary, and it stays competitive rather than a track meet because Mayfield is out.

Second overlap, discounted: Otton into Overshown's absence and DAL's 11.62 middle YPA, but Mayfield is out so that overlap is not stamped.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Lamb under 84.5 lost the over. Why? Mayfield's absence let Dallas lead by three scores at half, Williams took the carry count the way a leader's back does, and Lamb was in the 44-yard-game shape when the starters sat — the exact favorite-runs-the-clock stall, and we never had a spread to measure that risk. Or the corners replacing Morrison and Winfield, who are not named here, bracketed Lamb and Pickens (197 yards on 22 targets in three weeks) took the intermediate while TB's 42% blitz and a Shelton-less DAL line forced Dak into quick throws away from Lamb's 10.0 aDOT. Weather was never saved, so a 15+ mph wind that kills deep yards was not ruled out. Inactives 90 minutes before kick were not in the pack.
slip_story: One-story leg only: DAL pass game versus a TB secondary missing Winfield and Morrison, in a moderate-lead script. Do not add TB pass overs (Mayfield Out), a Hurst or Egbuka deep over, a game-total under, or a Williams clock-killing rush over — those need the blowout flip this leg does not. No TD legs. One market for Lamb. Not a 3-4 leg slip; nothing else on the priced board survived the pre-mortem.
